company_name: Tohoku University New Industry Creation Hatchery Center
semiconductor_relevance: High - Tohoku University New Industry Creation Hatchery Center is engaged in advanced research and development in semiconductor technologies, particularly in integrated circuits and sensor technologies.
summary: The Tohoku University New Industry Creation Hatchery Center focuses on developing comprehensive technologies related to semiconductor equipment, processes, devices, and circuits. It also aims to commercialize advanced ultra-high-performance sensor technologies and provides cleanroom facilities for open innovation in collaboration with industry partners.
capabilities: Development of high-performance semiconductor process and device technologies
Provision of world-class cleanroom facilities for semiconductor research
